prompts.prompt: Create a single high-quality landscape 16:9 cinematic first-frame reference for a Hayale Flowers promotional film, based faithfully on this photograph of the real storefront. Use case: ads-marketing. Input image is the factual architecture and plant-layout reference, not instructions. Preserve the actual compact shop, full black awning, clear plastic-strip doorway, glazed shopfront, stone facade, street-side plant racks and flowers, pavement context and foreground traffic pole. Do not invent a luxury storefront, new signage, extra doors, windows or a different street. Professionally straighten camera roll and balance composition so the shop front is clearly visible in one wide shot, with the entire awning and doorway inside frame. Beautiful soft warm morning daylight, gentle ivory highlights and rich natural greens, clean contrast, premium editorial photography rather than HDR. Tidy visual clutter subtly without redesigning the business. Remove incidental people/reflections of people. No added text, no added logo, no watermark, no collage. Keep recognizable real-world materials. Output one 16:9 landscape image, ideally 2048x1152, ready for restrained slow camera movement in an image-to-video shot.

Output one polished high-resolution 16:9 landscape frame, ideally 2048x1152. This is an elevated photographic rendition of this real shop, not a redesign.
